This race of '''blue-skinned humanoids''' were native to a [[Unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|planet]]. Their homeworld was the location of the [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] defeated an entire Separatist army using only a giant [[Chaingun/Legends|chaingun]]. [[Unidentified cantina patron|A cantina patron]] was a member of this species.
